title: Windows versions and editions and their differences

videos.script: The office needs two new computers, and the shop has them in two prices. The same model, the same processor, the same disk. One says Windows 11 Home and the other says Windows 11 Pro, and the difference is enough to make somebody ask whether it matters. {{shop}} It does, and the reason is not speed. Both run the same programs equally fast. The difference is what the computer can join, and who can manage it once it has. {{join}} And editions are only half of what Windows means by version. There is also the yearly feature update, which decides how long a PC keeps receiving fixes, and the build number, which is what programs actually check. {{numbers}} You will read a winver window completely, and know when a version stops being supported. You will tell the editions apart by what they allow, choose one for an office, and change edition without reinstalling. And you will recognise the Windows that are not on a shop shelf. {{steps}} No Windows machine was used to record this lesson. The screens are described, and the commands are the ones you would type there. {{honest}}
